title: EmoPyLab: A Tensor-Native, Hardware-Accelerated Laboratory for High-Throughput Benchmarking and Decision-Making in Multi/Many-Objective Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2603.01345v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper presents \textit{EmoPyLab}, an open-source, tensor-native Python framework for high-throughput benchmarking, analysis, and multi-criteria decision-making in multi- and many-objective optimization ($M \ge 2$). Traditional evolutionary toolchains rely on object-oriented Array-of-Structures (AoS) models that incur memory fragmentation and interpreter overhead during large campaigns, while emerging tensor engines focus primarily on single-objective neuroevolution, lacking high-dimensional analytics and post-Pareto decision support. EmoPyLab resolves this dichotomy via a contiguous Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) columnar data model executed across a 5-tier backend dispatch engine (NVIDIA CUDA, Apple MLX, JAX, CuPy, and CPU SIMD) with zero-copy persistence. The platform incorporates deductive Efficient Non-dominated Sorting ($O(M N \sqrt{N})$) and a low-discrepancy quasi-Monte Carlo Hypervolume estimator (Fast-MC HV) with Sobol seque

translated_title: EmoPyLab：一个面向多目标/许多目标优化中高吞吐量基准测试与决策的张量原生、硬件加速实验室
translated_abstract: 本文提出了EmoPyLab，一个开源的、张量原生的Python框架，用于多目标和许多目标优化（M ≥ 2）中的高吞吐量基准测试、分析与多准则决策。传统进化计算工具链依赖面向对象的结构数组模型，在大规模实验中会带来内存碎片化和解释器开销；而新兴的张量引擎主要聚焦于单目标神经进化，缺乏高维分析能力和帕累托后决策支持。EmoPyLab通过连续存储的结构数集列式数据模型解决了这一矛盾，该模型在5层后端调度引擎（NVIDIA CUDA、Apple MLX、JAX、CuPy和CPU SIMD）上运行，并支持零拷贝持久化。该平台集成了演绎式高效非支配排序算法（复杂度为O(M N √N)）以及基于Sobol序列的低差异准蒙特卡罗超体积估计器（Fast-MC HV）……
tldr: EmoPyLab是一个开源张量原生Python框架，通过SoA列式数据模型和覆盖CUDA、MLX、JAX、CuPy与CPU SIMD的5层硬件后端调度引擎，为多/许多目标优化提供高吞吐量基准测试、高效非支配排序、准蒙特卡罗超体积估计与多准则决策支持。
en_tdlr: EmoPyLab is an open-source tensor-native Python framework that leverages an SoA columnar data model with a 5-tier hardware backend dispatch engine (CUDA, MLX, JAX, CuPy, CPU SIMD) to enable high-throughput benchmarking, efficient non-dominated sorting, quasi-Monte Carlo hypervolume estimation, and multi-criteria decision-making for multi/many-objective optimization.
